"import csv
from collections import defaultdict
from openpyxl import Workbook

input_path = "eng_bom_01.csv"
output_path = "output.xlsx"

# Aggregate by part_no
parts = {}
with open(input_path, "r", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    reader = csv.DictReader(f)
    for row in reader:
        part_no = row["part_no"]
        qty = float(row["qty"]) if row["qty"] not in (None, "") else 0.0
        if part_no in parts:
            parts[part_no]["qty_total"] += qty
        else:
            parts[part_no] = {
                "desc": row["desc"],
                "qty_total": qty,
                "unit": row["unit"],
            }

# Sort by part_no ascending (string sort)
sorted_parts = sorted(parts.items(), key=lambda kv: kv[0])

# Write workbook
wb = Workbook()
ws = wb.active
ws.title = "BOM"

header = ["part_no", "desc", "qty_total", "unit"]
ws.append(header)

for part_no, info in sorted_parts:
    ws.append([
        part_no,
        info["desc"],
        round(info["qty_total"]),
        info["unit"],
    ])

wb.save(output_path)"
